name: slot-game
_toolchain: This sandbox has no network access to the npm registry (verified: even already-installed packages 403). The plan called for TypeScript + Vite + Vitest + jsdom, but none of that is installable here, so this deliberately uses only Node 22 built-ins instead: node --test as the runner, plain .js ES modules (no bundler needed, loads natively in both Node and browsers), and scripts/dev-server.js (node:http) in place of a vite dev server. Revisit this once the toolchain can actually be installed.
